ci:
jobs:
  lane:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - { check: Engineering }
    steps:
      - run: npx --no kaal-guard run --check ${{ matrix.check }} --github
  guard:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: node --test packages/kaal-guard/test/unit/*.test.mjs engineering/guard/acceptance/*.test.mjs
  guard-hosts:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - { host: Windows, os: windows-latest }
          - { host: macOS, os: macos-latest }
    steps:
      - run: node engineering/guard/suites.mjs
